changes.description: PR #15 review round 7 — ship #008 with ATR stops enabled: config.yaml trade_plan.stop_loss_method fixed_pct -> atr (pre-#008 engine already preferred ATR×2 stops, so fixed_pct as default regressed orchestrator output to a flat 5% stop). Added test_shipped_stop_method.py pinning the shipped method to atr (fails on revert) and asserting the no-config code default stays fixed_pct.
